interest: Indexes the 1937 Hamada–Terauchi 'harakiri debate' and the Hayashi cabinet's sudden Diet dissolution.
overview: Three 1937 cross-reference sheets on the Diet: the party–Army clash and prorogation, and dissolution of the House of Representatives before the April 30 election.

people.name: Joseph W. Ballantine
people.role: Officer, Division of Far Eastern Affairs, U.S. Department of State

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a telegram reporting conflict between the Army and political parties in the Diet and the resulting prorogation.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's Telegram No. 13 (January 22, 1937) on the Hamada–Terauchi clash and Diet prorogation.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Telegram No. 13 from Grew (Tokyo) on Diet Conflict and Prorogation

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a State Department memorandum analyzing the political crisis and dissolution of the House of Representatives.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Ballantine's March 31, 1937 memo on the House dissolution and April 30 election.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Memorandum by Ballantine on Japanese Political Crisis and Dissolution

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a telegram reporting the dissolution of the Lower House and the date of the general election.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's Telegram No. 101 (March 30, 1937): Lower House dissolved, election set for April 30.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Telegram No. 101 from Grew (Tokyo) on Dissolution of the Lower House
